title: Frontend: Deep Omit
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Deep Omit. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution({value,keys}). Recursively omit matching own property names from JSON objects, keeping array positions and recursively processing their values. Return a new structure; no prototype traversal.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Traverse supported containers and build new ones without changing the source.
alternativeApproaches: Support path-pattern omission and explain how it differs from removing every key with the same name.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Nested key; array of objects; null.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
